title: E-ticket detail request timeout
text: Ticketing service failed while calling the downstream provider for e-ticket details. Error: downstream provider timed out. Root cause: a provider connectivity issue caused request timeouts. Resolution: provider connectivity was restored and ticketing service pods were restarted.

title: Payment API returned HTTP 500
text: Payment service requests failed during database access with HTTP 500. Error: unable to acquire database connection. Root cause: the database connection pool was exhausted. Resolution: the connection pool configuration was increased and the payment service was restarted.

title: Masterdata connection unavailable
text: Masterdata service could not connect to its downstream database. Error: connection unavailable. Root cause: the database endpoint was temporarily unavailable. Resolution: database connectivity was restored and the application recovered.

title: No e-ticket found
text: The e-ticket detail API returned no items for the supplied input. Error: NO ITEMS FOUND FOR SPECIFIED INPUT. Root cause: the requested e-ticket information was not available in the downstream system. Resolution: ticket details were validated and the downstream request input was corrected.
